title: BesMella.Quake Season 2
wikitext:
== Introduction ==
20 players signed up for [[BesMella.Quake Season 1]], which was also the maximum for this tourney. The tourney consisted of a group stage, where the 8 best players went off to a 2 bracket play off. The map pool consisted [[dm2]], [[dm4]] and [[dm6]], also known as [[TB3]].

* Running date: 12th February to 22nd March [[2012]]
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/duelmania #duelmania] ([[QuakeNet]])
* Website: [http://quakeworld.tourney.cc/ BesMella.Quake Season 2]
* Signups: [http://quakeworld.tourney.cc/2/sign-ups/ 20 players]

== Streams ==



== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]]
* Allowed clients: [[FTEQW]] 1.00 and [[FodQuake]] 0.2 and [[ezQuake]] 2.1 or 2.1.1 with -ruleset smackdown
* Time limit: 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* No Powerups
* No fairpacks
* Discharges enabled
* Ktpro spawns. (unless both players agree on a different mode)
* Maxfps 77.
* No berzerk, midair, instagib or other unusual modes.
* Fallbunny on.
